svg.title: Raw agreement collapses under chance correction, Cohen's kappa on 20 tickets
svg.desc: Two human raters, A and B, each label 20 support tickets urgent or not urgent. Rows are rater A (urgent, not urgent); columns are rater B (urgent, not urgent). The four cells hold both-urgent = 2, A-urgent-B-not (disagree) = 1, A-not-B-urgent (disagree) = 1, and both-not = 16, colored emerald on the agreement diagonal and amber on the disagreement diagonal. Row totals are 3 and 17, column totals are 3 and 17, grand total 20. From these counts: raw agreement po = (2 plus 16) divided by 20 = 0.90, chance agreement pe = 0.15 times 0.15 plus 0.85 times 0.85 = 0.0225 plus 0.7225 = 0.7450, and Cohen's kappa = (0.90 minus 0.745) divided by (1 minus 0.745) = 0.61. A footnote reports that with three raters on five fresh tickets, Fleiss' kappa, built the same way from observed agreement 0.7333 and chance agreement 0.52, comes out to 0.44.
